properBeds.evidence: At least one distinct standard bed is visible in the bedroom; indices 11–14 are repeated views of the same bed. Other bedrooms are not represented in the reviewed photos.

bedLayout.value: Listing advertises 5 beds across 3 bedrooms; its description mentions a sofa bed and a bed in the basement, but the full sleeping layout is unclear. Photos show one distinct standard bed (indices 11–14 repeat the same bed).
bedLayout.evidence: "3 bedrooms"; "5 beds"; "guests sleeping on the sofa bed"; "1 bar on the basement"

toilets.evidence: Two distinct WC fixtures are visible: one in the bathroom and one in a separate WC room. This is a lower bound; the listing's 2.5 bathrooms is not treated as a WC count.

showers.evidence: Two distinct shower areas are visible in separate bathrooms; count is a lower bound.

internalStairs.evidence: Photo 36 shows a full staircase leading to a lower level.

kitchenQuality.evidence: Kitchen has contemporary-looking fitted green cabinetry and integrated appliances.

diningSeats.evidence: Dining setup shows three chairs and a bench with room for at least two people; lower-bound visual count.

enrichment.summary: Three-bedroom listing advertises five beds, but photos confirm only one distinct standard bed and the description mentions a sofa bed and an unclear basement sleeping place. Two shower areas and two WCs are visible. A staircase leads to the basement sleeping space; kitchen, oven, cooker, dishwasher, fridge, washer, AC and Wi-Fi are listed.

photoReview.bestPhotoReason: Bright, clear view of the main living and dining space with kitchen visible; stronger overall cover than the close room or appliance shots.
